unit: line group (all studies, states, donors, clones)
fold_rule: fold = floor(N * U(sha256(salt + ":fold:" + target_key))); key = Ensembl ID reconciled in P0

regimes.C: held group removed from every fit; target needs QC-passing support in another group
regimes.J: held group removed; held fold keys removed from every table (aliases merged by key)
regimes.T: held fold keys removed from every table; the group stays (diagnostic only)

qc: rows with < 10 cells are not evaluable nor training; lost rows are listed, never reassigned
